snippet.title: Ball Buster Breakout - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Ball Buster Breakout - Official Announcement Trailer

💥GRAB YOUR BALLS AND GET READY TO BUST. 💥


🎮👉 Wishlist on Steam right now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4459830/Ball_Buster_Breakout/

Ball Buster Breakout is a hyper-kinetic incremental idle clicker that mashes brick-breaking chaos with deep idle progression.

Aim, fire, obliterate, repeat

Stack rarity-tiered power-ups, battle massive bosses, prestige for permanent growth, and ride an original glitch-bass soundtrack by Bobi Meijer that'll get you higher than your DPS.

This is Breakout re-born as an addictive idle/incremental monster. Brick go down, number go up.
